title: mentha aquatica var. subsativa
intro: Mentha aquatica var. subsativa, commonly known as American watermint, is a variety of the watermint plant, native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to relieve digestive issues, such as indigestion and nausea, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of American watermint include its ability to act as a carminative, relieving gas and bloating, and its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, making it effective in pain relief. The bioactive constituents of American watermint include menthone, menthyl acetate, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
